Counting the Even Numbers in an Array
30

Problem Statement
Read N integers into an array and print how many of them are even, using a loop combined with an if statement.
Description
Read an integer N, then read N integers into a one-dimensional array. Use another loop to go through the array, and use an if statement with the % operator to check whether each element is even. Increase a counter for every even element, and print the final count.
Input Description
An integer N (N >= 1), followed by N integers, all separated by spaces.
Output Description
Print the number of even elements in the array.
Sample Input
6 1 2 3 4 5 6
Sample Output
3
